# Copilot instructions

For every repository modification, read and follow the root `AGENTS.md`.

Always review and clean README files and comments in all repository files after changes. README content must remain logically correct and reflect the current repository state. Comments must be concise and contain no historical references. Preserve required license notices and tool directives.

Keep changes scoped to the request, preserve unrelated files and behavior, and run the validation commands in `AGENTS.md` before completing the task. Report validation limitations explicitly.
